caption: The drawing depicts a single, tall ceramic jar positioned upright in the center of the image on a plain, light-colored background. The jar is cylindrical with a slight taper towards the base and a wide, circular mouth. The exterior of the jar is a light beige or tan color with shading that indicates a smooth, glazed texture. Two small, rounded handles are attached to opposite sides near the top. Around the upper portion of the jar, there is an inscription in black that reads “M. WOODRUFF WHITE LAND 5”, with the number “5” positioned beneath the first two lines of text. The jar features a decorative floral design on the front, painted in a rich blue color, showing three stylized flower shapes with curved stems and leaves. The inside rim of the jar appears to be a darker brown or black, indicating depth. The base of the jar shows subtle discoloration in a brownish-orange shade, suggesting wear or staining. There are no additional objects or details in the composition.
title: Five Gallon Churn
